description: Ask a free-text question about one business. Returns the best-matching approved Q&As verbatim, each with sources and approval status, plus a coverage field: 'full' (the whole question was covered), 'partial' (only part of a multi-intent question matched; check what is missing), or 'none' (nothing matched; available_questions lists what this profile can answer). Use the business id from search_business.
name: ask_business
